description: Data acquisition — the remaining Phase 11 gaps: in-app authoring tools (map drawing, timeline entry, relationship builder), URL/text extractors, additional data pipelines (GeoNames, Open Context/tDAR, culture-scrape Wikidata), AI-assisted entry with review, and a hardened public contribution API. Excludes already-done bulk import, Glottolog, WALS.

userStories.title: Interactive map geometry drawing tool
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want to draw regions, trade routes, and migration paths directly on the map so I can author geographic data without editing TSV by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a click-to-draw component (a draw library such as leaflet-draw/terra-draw, or a custom handler) for polygons and lines on the main map
Drawn geometries persist as GeoJSON via a new POST endpoint and land in the appropriate lexicons/*.tsv (or the contribution queue) with provenance source='user-drawn'
Support editing/deleting a drawn shape before submit; associate it with an entity + time range
vitest tests cover geometry serialization and the persistence endpoint; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Timeline event authoring tool
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want to click the timeline to add events, period markers, and date ranges so temporal data is editable in-app.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a timeline authoring UI (click/drag on the temporal axis) that creates events/period markers with start/end years
New entries persist via an endpoint into the relevant TSV or the contribution queue with provenance
Validation rejects inverted or out-of-bounds ranges; entries link to an entity
vitest tests cover range validation and persistence; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Relationship builder (drag-and-drop entity linking)
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want to connect two entities by dragging one onto another so I can author relationships (e.g. Latin -> French) visually.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a drag-and-drop UI to create a typed edge between two entities (source, target, relationship_type, time range, confidence)
New edges persist into cultural-lineages.tsv (or the canonical edge export) with provenance; reuse the canonical edge vocabulary from tasklist 15
Prevent duplicate/self edges and surface the resulting relationship for confirmation
vitest tests cover edge creation + dedup; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Wikipedia/Wikidata URL-paste extractor
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want to paste a Wikipedia or Wikidata URL and get a pre-filled entity draft so I can add data quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add POST /api/extract/url that accepts a Wikipedia/Wikidata URL and returns a structured entity draft (name, coordinates, dates, relationships) with per-field confidence
For Wikidata URLs, resolve via the vendored culture-scrape acquisition (packages/culture-scrape/) rather than reimplementing SPARQL in TS
Extracted drafts are clearly marked AI/auto-derived and enter the contribution review queue, not the live dataset
vitest tests use recorded fixtures for the URL fetch; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Wire culture-scrape Wikidata/dump acquisition into the scraper dashboard
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want to trigger and monitor culture-scrape's Wikidata acquisition from the app so large-scale ingestion is operable without leaving LinguaScrape.
acceptanceCriteria: Add endpoints that invoke culture-scrape jobs (packages/culture-scrape/) for Wikidata SPARQL/dump acquisition of civilizations, sites, figures, and trade goods, and stream job status
Surface job progress/results in the existing scraper dashboard (client/src/components/scraper-dashboard.tsx)
Ingested data flows through the convergence pipeline (tasklists 15/10) with provenance; no duplicate TS SPARQL client is created
vitest tests mock the job runner; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: GeoNames place-resolution pipeline
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I want standardized place names and coordinates from GeoNames so locations are consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a GeoNames adapter alongside the existing Nominatim/OSM path in server/services/place-resolver.ts
Resolver prefers GeoNames IDs for standardized naming; falls back to Nominatim; results carry provenance
A resolve API returns canonical place records (name, lat/lng, geonames_id)
vitest tests use recorded GeoNames fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Open Context / tDAR archaeological pipeline
userStories.description: As a data engineer, I want archaeological site data from Open Context and tDAR so coverage extends beyond Pleiades.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Open Context and/or tDAR adapters complementing the existing Pleiades path in server/services/archaeological-site-scraper.ts
Imported sites carry coordinates, time ranges, associated cultures, and provenance
A scraping endpoint is wired into the scraper dashboard
vitest tests use recorded fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: LLM extraction from pasted text
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want to paste a paragraph and have entities, dates, relationships, and coordinates extracted so I can add data from papers/textbooks.
acceptanceCriteria: Add POST /api/extract/text using the existing Gemini client (as in server/services/map-image-analyzer.ts) to extract structured entities/dates/relationships from a text paragraph
Each extracted field carries a confidence score and is clearly flagged as AI-generated
Output is a draft that enters the review queue (US-009), never the live dataset directly
vitest tests mock the LLM with fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: AI-extraction review queue
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want AI-extracted drafts in a dedicated review workflow so nothing AI-generated enters the dataset unverified.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the contribution service so AI-extracted drafts (from US-004/US-008) are queued with an 'ai-generated' flag and per-field confidence
A review UI lets a human accept/edit/reject each field before commit; low-confidence fields are highlighted
Accepted drafts write to TSV/canonical export with provenance recording both the AI source and the human reviewer
vitest tests cover the queue transitions; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Authoring-time suggested relationships
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want relationship suggestions when adding an entity so likely connections are easy to confirm.
acceptanceCriteria: When creating/editing an entity, surface suggested relationships from existing proximity math (server/services/cross-domain-analysis.ts / cross-domain-correlation.ts) and the shared graph
Suggestions show rationale (temporal/spatial/linguistic proximity) and confidence; the user confirms to create the edge
Suggestions never auto-create edges
vitest tests cover suggestion ranking on fixtures; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Hardened public contribution API
userStories.description: As an external contributor, I want a documented, secured contribution API so programmatic contributions are safe and supported.
acceptanceCriteria: Add API key/token auth and per-key rate limiting to the contribution endpoints (server/services/contribution-service.ts, routes)
Publish an OpenAPI spec documenting the contribution + read endpoints
Reject unauthenticated writes; keep read endpoints open as configured
vitest tests cover auth + rate-limit paths; `npm run check` passes

userStories.title: Community verification & culture stewardship
userStories.description: As the community, we want multi-confirmation verification and domain ownership so data quality scales with contributors.
acceptanceCriteria: Add multi-confirmation: independent approvals from N distinct reviewers raise a contribution's confidence before it goes live
Add an 'adopt a culture' ownership model mapping stewards to cultural domains, surfaced in the contribution UI
Confidence and steward attribution are recorded with provenance
vitest tests cover the multi-confirmation threshold logic; `npm run check` passes
